# XML Sitemap

The XML Sitemap helps search engines discover and index FLVRTX content efficiently.

# Submission

Submit the sitemap to:

- Google Search Console

# Monitoring

Review sitemap after:

- Publishing new content
- Changing permalink structure
- Creating new content types

---

# Best Practices

- Keep URLs canonical.
- Avoid broken URLs.
- Remove deleted content promptly.
- Ensure sitemap updates automatically.

---

# Goal

Maintain an accurate and up-to-date sitemap that helps search engines discover all public FLVRTX content.
